anchors.paper_title: Optimal parameters for measuring multiband auditory brainstem responses to continuous speech
anchors.reason: The candidate paper title and abstract explicitly describe the optimal parameters and methodology for using continuous speech with the multiband peaky speech paradigm, which generated this dataset.

metadata.methods_description: EEG recordings were collected from participants seated in a sound-isolating booth while passively listening to audiobook stimuli presented at 65 dB SPL through ER-2 insert earphones at 48 kHz sampling rate. Experiment 1 (October-December 2022) presented 720 trials (120 minutes total) of multiband peaky speech with zero- or chirp-phase profiles. Experiment 2 (January-April 2023) presented 840 trials (140 minutes total) of multiband peaky speech from two narrators at natural and shifted fundamental frequencies (100 Hz). Stimulus presentation and experiment control were managed using custom Python scripts with expyfun. Raw EEG data were recorded in Brain Products format (.eeg, .vhdr, .vmrk files), with stimuli and regressors stored in HDF5 format.
